red_tests.failure_fingerprint: negative control: empty commit message (no agent-* label) must be rejected by legacy validate_commit_message path

rationale: Add test coverage for the fail-open design in cmd_check (Jira API verification). When Jira returns 404 (ticket-not-found), 401/403 (auth), or credentials are missing, cmd_check returns exit 2 (fail-open) rather than exit 1 (fail-closed). Only a confirmed ticket lacking an agent-* label triggers fail-closed. This preserves offline workflow continuity while enforcing governance when Jira is reachable.
